messages:
alex chan: deploy-bot flagged promote window for `aurora-service` chart v2.1.0 -> v2.2.0. eu-west has a spike on node pressure. thinking we should sequence promote + evacuation. who can own?

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight: `helm template` dry-run ok; kube precheck: nodePressure on node eu-west-2a (pod eviction risk). recommended action: staggered drain -> promote smaller batch.

maria gomez: I can take control. propose plan: 1) pin chart to v2.1.1 for edgezone, 2) patch values to reduce replicas to 2 in eu-west for 10m, 3) canary promote 10% traffic to v2.2.0 in other regions. Thoughts?

raj patel: +1 on pin for edgezone. But what about DB migration? Is there a preflight migration job?

alex chan: no DB migration in v2.2.0, just config for connection pooling. we should still run `kubectl rollout status` as gate.

jess li: I'll run a dry-run evac plan — commands below
```
kubectl cordon node/eu-west-2a
kubectl drain node/eu-west-2a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
helm upgrade aurora --install ./charts/aurora --set image.tag=2.2.0 --dry-run
```

maria gomez: good — timeline? If we start cordon at 12:10UTC, drain + canary should finish by 12:30. Deploy-bot, can you annotate the release notes to mention the temporary replica reduction and pin fallback?

deploy-bot: noted. release-notes updated: "Temporary replica reduction in eu-west during promotion; fallback pin to v2.1.1 available." :memo: 

raj patel: one more: if pod eviction leads to >=5% 503s in health check during canary, abort and pin. agreed?

alex chan: agreed. abort condition: service 5xx spike OR >20% pod restart in 15m window. fallback: `helm rollback aurora --version 210` and pin annotation `release.pin=v2.1.1`.

maria gomez: I'll monitor metrics. tagging oncall: @raj @alex

jess li: starting cordon now.

deploy-bot: [system] cordon succeeded on node/eu-west-2a at 1778889995

jess li: drain running, no pods evicted from critical svc.

maria gomez: canary promoted to 10% in US/asia. monitoring dashboards green so far.

raj patel: saw a 1% spike in error rate for 2m, within threshold.

alex chan: ok hold for 10m, if stable we proceed to 50% then full.

maria gomez: plan logged in release notes and internal runbook. I'll send summary when full promote completes. :tada:
